items.summary: Recommendation: approve containment-only execution. Authorize no new discretionary spend, monetization expansion, budget commitment, forecast, requeue, or production work. AI spend was $963.569 across 5,390 calls from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-26. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; site-attributed commission is $0 because the aggregate row cannot be assigned without inventing attribution. Contribution margin, ROI, cost-to-learn, causal lift, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because period-aligned infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, experiment costs, incremental outcomes, and owner-approved limits are absent. Minimum measurement: a period-aligned cost ledger matched to site-attributed commission, experiment-level cost and incremental outcomes, and approved monthly limits. Continue existing source-dated measurement, attribution reconciliation, failure repair-or-close review, and bounded legal/security evidence work only; do not treat impressions, clicks, sessions, conversions, technical scores, or aggregate commission as financial return.

Retain existing measurement and reconciliation work without creating duplicate finance requests. Revenue claims remain unsupported beyond the stated one-day aggregate provider result; no forecast, margin claim, or payback claim is justified. Infrastructure and other operating costs are unknown because no period-aligned ledger is present; the minimum required evidence is dated provider, domain, labor, marketing, and experiment-cost records reconciled to the same revenue window and site/content identifiers.

Maintain private launch gates and existing containment. No financial approval is supported for monetization expansion or external commitments while attribution, rights, security, and measurement evidence remain incomplete.
